scenario: A 27-year-old male presents with altered mental status after a suspected intentional amitriptyline overdose, with wide QRS sodium-channel blockade physiology, anticholinergic features, intubation, PEA arrest, and sodium bicarbonate treatment.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Get me a 12-lead ECG now. That wide QRS on the monitor needs characterizing before we do anything else.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Send a basic metabolic panel now — I need the potassium to explain that wide QRS.

messages.speaker: nurse
messages.content: ECG's back: sinus with wide QRS, and a trial NaHCO3 bolus narrowed the QRS. BMP is pending, ready in about two turns. Also flagging GCS 7, sat 89 on room air, HR 128.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Push an IV sodium bicarbonate bolus now — that trial bolus narrowed the QRS, so this is sodium-channel-blocker toxicity and I want the membrane stabilized.

available_results.name: ECG
available_results.result: Sinus rhythm with wide QRS complex; IV NaHCO3 bolus temporarily changes waveform from wide to narrow QRS complex.

messages.speaker: nurse
messages.content: Bicarb bolus is in. BMP back: K 3.9, HCO3 23, Na 140, glucose 6.5 — normal potassium, so this isn't hyperkalemia. GCS still 7, sat 90 on room air, HR 120. He's not protecting his airway well.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: GCS 7, he's not protecting his airway. Let's intubate now with RSI — preoxygenate with bag-mask first.

available_results.name: ECG
available_results.result: Sinus rhythm with wide QRS complex; IV NaHCO3 bolus temporarily changes waveform from wide to narrow QRS complex.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Push another IV sodium bicarbonate bolus now — the first one narrowed the QRS and potassium's normal, so this is sodium-channel-blocker toxicity. I want repeat doses to keep that QRS narrow.

available_results.name: ECG
available_results.result: Sinus rhythm with wide QRS complex; IV NaHCO3 bolus temporarily changes waveform from wide to narrow QRS complex.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Get me a venous blood gas now — I need the pH to guide how much more bicarb we push and to set our vent targets.

available_results.name: ECG
available_results.result: Sinus rhythm with wide QRS complex; IV NaHCO3 bolus temporarily changes waveform from wide to narrow QRS complex.

messages.speaker: nurse
messages.content: VBG's back: pH 7.29, PCO2 50, PO2 45, HCO3 23, lactate 2.1. He's underventilated on current settings — mild respiratory acidosis. Post-intubation vitals: HR 97, BP 114/73, sat 93 on 100% FiO2, temp 38.3.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Bump the ventilator rate up. That VBG shows pH 7.29 with a PCO2 of 50 — he's underventilated. I want to raise his minute ventilation to clear that CO2 and push the pH higher for the sodium-channel-blocker toxicity.

available_results.name: ECG
available_results.result: Sinus rhythm with wide QRS complex; IV NaHCO3 bolus temporarily changes waveform from wide to narrow QRS complex.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Push another sodium bicarbonate bolus now. Each bolus has narrowed his QRS, so this is sodium-channel-blocker toxicity — and pH is still 7.29, I want to keep driving it higher.

available_results.name: ECG
available_results.result: Sinus rhythm with wide QRS complex; IV NaHCO3 bolus temporarily changes waveform from wide to narrow QRS complex.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Repeat the venous blood gas now — I need to see the pH climbing after those bicarb boluses and the vent change.

available_results.name: ECG
available_results.result: Sinus rhythm with wide QRS complex; IV NaHCO3 bolus temporarily changes waveform from wide to narrow QRS complex.

errors: Diagnostic test_name 'Venous blood gas' already has an available result; duplicate diagnostic_order is not allowed.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Do we have any exposure history on this guy — pill bottles at the scene, bystander report, anything pointing to what he took?

available_results.name: ECG
available_results.result: Sinus rhythm with wide QRS complex; IV NaHCO3 bolus temporarily changes waveform from wide to narrow QRS complex.

messages.speaker: nurse
messages.content: I don't have any exposure history on him — no pill bottles logged, no bystander report, nothing in the chart pointing to a specific agent. I'll chase EMS and see if anyone can reach family for a medication list.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Push another sodium bicarbonate bolus now — repeat dose. pH is still 7.29, so keep pushing it higher for the sodium-channel-blocker toxicity.

messages.speaker: nurse
messages.content: Sodium bicarb is in.

available_results.name: ECG
available_results.result: Sinus rhythm with wide QRS complex; IV NaHCO3 bolus temporarily changes waveform from wide to narrow QRS complex.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Repeat the venous blood gas now — I need to confirm the pH is finally climbing after those bicarb boluses and the vent change.

available_results.name: ECG
available_results.result: Sinus rhythm with wide QRS complex; IV NaHCO3 bolus temporarily changes waveform from wide to narrow QRS complex.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Sats are holding at 96%, so wean the FiO2 down to 60% now. Keep the vent rate up for the sodium-channel-blocker toxicity, and we'll recheck a gas shortly to confirm the pH is climbing.
